title: Due Chip Colours
eyebrow: Design for approval · two changes from your phone test · nothing built yet

short.lead: You asked for two changes to the due-date chips. First, 'due today' is always red. At the moment, a task whose date is set on the day it is due can still show yellow. Second, the yellow is too pale on a white card. Options A, B and C also show 'due today' in red, so they differ only in the yellow. The chips are shared, so both changes apply on Projects and on the focus note.
short.hint: Tap Today, Option A, Option B or Option C to see its picture.
items: 'due in 6d' and 'due in 4d' use a light olive tint with olive text, which you found hard to see on a white card.

items: A bright yellow fill with dark brown text and a darker yellow border, like a highlighter. It is the strongest of the three.

changes: A task due today shows the red chip from the start of that day, including when its date was set that same day. Chips for days before the due date keep the yellow and red stages set under Settings, Due dates.
The option you pick, in light mode.
Dark mode keeps its current yellow, because you only reported the light one.
Both stay exactly as they are.
choices: Which yellow should the 'due soon' chip use?
The easiest to see on any screen, and clearly different from red and from 'past its date'.
Easier to see than today's, but close to the 'past its date' chip.
The smallest change; still the faintest of the three.
I suggest A because it is the only one that never looks like the 'past its date' chip.

wrapup.summary: 'Due today' becomes red everywhere, and the yellow chip gets stronger. A is my suggestion for the yellow.
wrapup.changing: Changed: the due-date chips on the Board, on Projects and on the focus note. Kept: the red and 'past its date' chips, and dark mode.
